LanguageData.RimWard.FirstStartPitch: RimWard turns your medical beds into a hospital that strangers pay to be patched up in. A new colony starts with the hospital open and every medical bed takes patients; the Hospital tab lists what is still missing. Clinic is the normal game, Charity treats for free, Meat shop pays more and forgives deaths. Everything can be changed later in Mod settings.
LanguageData.RimWard.Section.intake.Desc: Patients arrive by drop pod while the hospital is open. Off: nobody new comes and no contracts are offered; patients already here are treated and leave as usual.
LanguageData.RimWard.Section.surgery.Desc: Some patients come for an operation your colony can do (a bionic, a cataract, a carcinoma). Off: no new surgery patients; operations already planned still happen.
LanguageData.RimWard.Section.mce.Desc: Now and then a pandemic, raid, crash or fire sends several patients at once, never more than you have free patient beds. Each colony still opts in under Hospital policies.
LanguageData.RimWard.Section.complications.Desc: Patients may bring a harmless second illness (such as gut worms), a chronic condition or a harmless addiction. Never anything that can kill them or send them berserk.
LanguageData.RimWard.Section.billing.Desc: Partial pay when a patient leaves early, reimbursement after a failed operation, invoice letters for big payouts. Off: the plain bill, paid in full when cured and nothing otherwise.
LanguageData.RimWard.Section.malpractice.Desc: A patient who dies through your fault costs goodwill with their faction. Deaths you could not prevent never do.
LanguageData.RimWard.Section.renown.Desc: Good outcomes build the hospital's renown in four tiers (Field Aid, Clinic, Hospital, Medical Hub). Every tier above Field Aid pays 5% more: +5%, +10%, +15%.
LanguageData.RimWard.Section.royalty.Desc: Titled patients want a private room: they pay 40% more for one and 25% less for a shared one.
LanguageData.RimWard.Section.ideology.Desc: Colonists whose ideoligion has the Guilty meme feel bad when the hospital turns the sick away.
LanguageData.RimWard.Section.hearth.Desc: With Hearth & Harbor: one bed button for Colonist / Guest / Patient / Surgery patient, and patients who are up and about may use its spa.
LanguageData.RimWard.Section.ce.Desc: With Combat Extended: patients never tend themselves with CE's tactical self-tend; your doctors treat them.
LanguageData.RimWard.Section.luciferium.Desc: With Luciferium Overhaul: now and then a patient comes whom only luciferium can help. A doctor administers one dose from your stock and the patient pays very well; they go home dependent on it, and their people keep them supplied.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.difficulty.Desc: Scales how badly patients are wounded or ill and how many complications they bring.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.openInNewColonies: Open the hospital in new colonies
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.openInNewColonies.Des: A new colony starts with the hospital open. Nobody comes until there is a patient bed (a medical bed with its "Hospital Bed" switch on). Existing saves keep what they had.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.specialNeedsXenotypes: Off: patients who live on hemogen or need a deathrest casket are not sent. Their faction's own xenotype is always kept.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.messageAtArrival: Arrival as a message instead of a letter
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.messageAtArrival.Desc: Routine arrivals show a short message at the top of the screen instead of a letter.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.maxStayDays.Desc: After this many days a patient is discharged with the full bill so far. 0 = no limit.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.impossibleHours.Desc: A pending operation that cannot be done (part gone, nobody skilled enough, missing ingredient, refused) sends a letter after this time and discharges the patient after the same time again. No penalty.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.dangerHoldHours: Cured patients wait for danger at most (hours)
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.dangerHoldHours.Desc: Only active threats count (raiders, manhunters). Dormant mech clusters and weather never hold anyone.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.chargePatients.Desc: Off: a charity ward. Nobody pays, goodwill still counts.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.payment.Desc: How much patients pay compared with what their treatment cost you. Break-even covers medicine and work.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.customPayment.Desc: Used when the payment scale is Custom.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.billCap.Desc: No patient pays more than this, however long the bill.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.medicinePreference.De: Tribal patients dislike glitterworld medicine, modern ones dislike herbal medicine: they pay less when treated with it. Strict doubles the effect.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.singleRoom.Desc: Pay multiplier for a patient who rested in a room of their own.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.twoBedRoom.Desc: Pay multiplier for a room with two beds.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.barracks.Desc: Pay multiplier for a room with three or more beds. A bed in a hallway pays 85% of this.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.chiefPhysician.Desc: Patients treated by a highly skilled doctor pay more and leave happier.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.chiefSkill.Desc: The best doctor who treated the patient needs at least this Medicine skill.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.chiefMultiplier.Desc: Pay multiplier when the chief physician bonus applies.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.intakeMode.Desc: Hybrid (default): wound and disease cases just arrive; a letter asks first for surgery cases and nobles, because an operation may use parts and medicine from your stock. Firehose: every patient just arrives, operations included. Prompt: a letter for every case, with diagnosis and estimated pay.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.triageHours.Desc: An offer letter you do not answer expires after this time. Declining is free.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.contracts: Treat injured visitors on the map (contracts)
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.contracts.Desc: When visitors, traders or allies get hurt on your map, they offer to pay for treatment.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.autoRetry.Desc: A botched operation is attempted again instead of sending the patient home uncured.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.maxRetries.Desc: How often a failed operation is attempted again.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.earlyPay.Desc: Share of the bill so far that a patient pays when sent home early, when treatment is impossible, or after a death that is not your fault.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.noFaultDeathPays: A death that is not your fault still pays
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.noFaultDeathPays.Desc: The bill so far times the share above is paid when a patient dies and it was not your fault.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.reimburseMedicine: Reimburse medicine after a failed operation
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.reimburseMedicine.Des: After a failed operation the patient's people pay for the medicine it used up. There is no fee for the operation itself.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.reimburseParts: Reimburse parts after a failed operation
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.reimburseParts.Desc: After a failed operation the patient's people pay for the parts it used up (prosthetics, organs).
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.invoiceLetter.Desc: Discharges that pay at least this much silver send a letter with the itemised invoice. Smaller ones send a message.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.deathPenalty: Goodwill lost per death at fault
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.deathPenalty.Desc: Goodwill the patient's faction takes off when a death is your fault.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.noFaultSurgery: No penalty for deaths in surgery
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.noFaultSurgery.Desc: A patient dying on the operating table, or soon after a botched operation, is clinical risk, not your fault.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.noFaultLeaving: No penalty for deaths after dismissal
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.noFaultLeaving.Desc: A patient you sent home who dies on the way is not your fault.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.noFaultDoomed: No penalty if dying on arrival
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.noFaultDoomed.Desc: A patient who dies within an hour of arriving was beyond help.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.combinedBedButton.Des: One "Use: Colonist / Guest / Patient / Surgery patient" button instead of separate hospital, surgery and guest bed toggles. Needs a Hearth & Harbor version with the selector protocol.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.patientLeisure.Desc: Patients who are up and about (not bleeding, no operation waiting) may visit Hearth & Harbor's spa and other leisure places while they recover.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.criticalChance: Share of patients who are critical
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.criticalChance.Desc: Chance that a new patient is a critical case, when you have luciferium in stock and a doctor who can administer it.
LanguageData.RimWard.Setting.rw.criticalBonus.Desc: Fee on top of the dose itself, as a multiple of the value of one luciferium.
LanguageData.RimWard.Preset.clinic.Desc: The normal game: patients pay what their treatment cost you, deaths through your fault cost goodwill.
LanguageData.RimWard.Preset.charity.Desc: Nobody pays. Goodwill and renown still grow with every patient you send home healthy.
LanguageData.RimWard.Preset.meatshop.Desc: Volume over bedside manners: tougher cases, generous pay, deaths are nobody's fault, nobody stays longer than a week.
LanguageData.RimWard.Compat.HospitalBedsGen2.What: Its beds are medical beds, so they count as patient and surgery beds automatically.
LanguageData.RimWard.Compat.HearthHarbor.What: One bed button for all bed uses; patients may use the spa. Switch: the Hearth & Harbor bridge area.
LanguageData.RimWard.Compat.LuciferiumOverhaul.What: Offers the Luciferium critical cases area (off until you switch it on); its addiction rules apply after the dose.
LanguageData.RimWard.Compat.CombatExtended.What: CE's tactical self-tend is blocked for patients. Switch: the Combat Extended area.
LanguageData.RimWard.Compat.Royalty.What: Noble patients want a private room.
LanguageData.RimWard.Compat.Ideology.What: Guilty ideoligions mind turning the sick away.
LanguageData.RimWard.Compat.Biotech.What: Patients keep their faction's xenotype; hemogen and deathrest xenotypes stay home unless you allow them.
LanguageData.RimWard.Compat.Odyssey.What: Hospital policies belong to the save, so they come along after a gravship landing.
LanguageData.RimWard.Compat.Hospital.Why: RimWard is the rebuilt successor of Hospital: use only one of the two.
LanguageData.RimWard.Compat.HospitalFixAndTweak.Why: Its fixes are part of RimWard already.
LanguageData.RimWard.Compat.HospitalPatch.Why: Patches the Hospital mod, which RimWard replaces.
LanguageData.RimWard.Card.openHospital.Tip: Opens the hospital in this colony. Patients come as soon as a medical bed takes patients.
LanguageData.RimWard.Card.useBeds: Use all medical beds for patients
LanguageData.RimWard.Card.useBeds.Tip: Every medical bed of this colony gets its "Hospital Bed" switch turned on. New medical beds take patients by default anyway.
